implement.approach: Test-first. (1) Regression test df4c6539 spawns the same bounded probe (Node --max-old-space-size=192, 5000 ms SIGKILL, 1 MiB output cap) that requires metro.config.js and asserts metro-transform-worker and @babel/core are NOT in require.cache after config load, that ICNS bytes disguised as .png are still rejected ('disabled file type: icns'), and that requiring config.transformerPath afterwards yields exactly the upstream transform/getCacheKey functions (identity) while the worker graph is larger than the config graph. Fails on BASE (true !== false), passes on HEAD. (2) Fix 0e6b5621 in apps/mobile/scripts/metro-asset-transformer.cjs: keep the immediate image-size disableTypes(['icns','jxl','heif']) guard, replace `module.exports = require('metro-transform-worker')` with a memoised lazy require exposed through `transform`/`getCacheKey` getters, so the upstream worker (and @babel/core) loads only when Metro's worker or cache-key computation touches it. metro.config.js is unchanged and still wires transformerPath to this file, so the shipping Metro path is affected. (3) The probe's fd-3 phase markers now also carry process.resourceUsage() majorPageFault / fsRead / involuntaryContextSwitches / voluntaryContextSwitches so a recurrence of the 5 s stall can be attributed to cold-IO (major faults) vs CPU starvation (involuntary switches, wall >> cpu) vs module work; marker count (32) and output caps unchanged.

implement.summary: DEFECT ON BASE_SHA (VERIFIED): apps/mobile/scripts/metro-asset-transformer.cjs:16 `module.exports = require('metro-transform-worker')` executes at config-load time because apps/mobile/metro.config.js:4 requires that file (and :56 sets it as transformerPath). Every Metro config evaluation — Metro's main process and the guard child in __tests__/wf/be-mobile-security-secrets.test.ts (buildProbe, 5000 ms / 192 MB / SIGKILL) — therefore also loaded @babel/core and the transform-worker graph (62 modules, ~16 ms warm, 3757→3201 statx, 2232→2014 openat, 633→568 total modules) that only transform workers need. Fixed with a lazy, identity-preserving delegate (see approach). REPRODUCTION (VERIFIED, not reproduced): the cold-cache tracing from cba1eabf plus rm -rf /tmp/metro-* between runs never hit the 5 s deadline on this Linux runner across: focused suite cold x6, full suite cold x2 (BASE and HEAD), scripts/verify-cloud.sh --only mobile (exit 0, 271 s), direct cold probes (193–209 ms), page-cache-evicted probes (~59k files evicted; 260–302 ms), 8/32 CPU-oversubscribed probes (399–565 / 817–1103 ms), and 32 busy processes + continuous page-cache eviction (1035–1799 ms max). strace -f -c of the config child shows no network, no child processes and no Metro cache IO — the work is pure module loading (~2.2k openat / ~3.8k statx) whose wall time is dominated by thread waits (futex 74.8 %, epoll_pwait 20.5 %). ROOT-CAUSE CLASSIFICATION: module graph (VERIFIED composition: 72 % of the config graph is Sentry — @sentry/core 232 modules on import plus 203 @babel/types|traverse|generator + metro-source-map modules pulled in by withSentryDebugId's serializer; 10 % was this package's eager transform-worker; the remainder @react-native/metro-config + image-size). The 5 s wall itself was not reproduced, so the trigger on the original runner is INFERRED to be host IO/CPU starvation making that module graph cold (the evicted+oversubscribed experiment reached 36 % of the deadline); the Sentry share is outside write_paths and required at config time by Sentry's API. The fix removes the part of the graph the package owns and is general (it also speeds Metro's own config load); it does not make the config child immune to a starved host, and the new resourceUsage markers exist so the next occurrence is classifiable instead of a bare timeout. ACCEPTANCE: REGRESS proof PASS (base fail / head pass), AC1 PASS 5/5 cold (44 passed each, 0 skipped), AC3 PASS, AC4 PASS (+ pnpm format:check, git diff --check), AC2 FAIL only on the pre-existing artifact-gated describe.skip in importedRealFootageAnalysis.test.ts (identical on BASE_SHA; recorded, not waived; all 5890 executed tests passed, 0 failures). Guards unchanged: 5000 ms, --max-old-space-size=192, 1 MiB maxBuffer, SIGKILL, 32-record marker cap. Commits: df4c6539 (test), 0e6b5621 (fix); pushed to origin devin/pp/p0-01/impl-r1; no PR opened; nothing outside write_paths touched.

implement.summary: DEFECT ON BASE_SHA (VERIFIED): apps/mobile/metro.config.js:4 requires ./scripts/metro-asset-transformer.cjs during config construction (so the image-size ICNS/JXL/HEIF guard is installed in Metro's config process) and :56 also sets it as transformerPath. On BASE_SHA metro-asset-transformer.cjs:16 did `module.exports = require('metro-transform-worker')` eagerly, so every config load — including the 5 s / 192 MB child probes in __tests__/wf/be-mobile-security-secrets.test.ts — also loaded the whole transform toolchain (metro-transform-worker + @babel/core + gensync/semver/metro-cache-key: 62 modules, ~319 KiB) that Metro only needs inside transform workers. Measured config graph: 633 modules / 3330 KiB on base vs 571 / 3011 KiB on the candidate; the remaining 571 are @sentry/react-native/metro (~457 modules incl. @sentry/core and the Metro serializer + @babel/traverse it pulls in), @react-native/metro-config and metro-config — third-party and outside write_paths. REPRODUCTION (VERIFIED): the timeout is IO-bound, not CPU-bound. Warm, the config child completes in ~170-260 ms and never exceeded 258 ms across the whole full-suite run (concurrent probe log) — so CPU contention alone does not reproduce it on this VM. With node_modules evicted from the page cache and read IOPS throttled via cgroup io.max (riops=600) the base config child exceeded 5 s and was SIGKILLed with the bounded tracer showing thousands of majorPageFault/fsRead before 'config-ready'; at riops 300/500/800 base took ~2.4/1.4/0.9 s vs candidate ~2.2/1.3/0.85 s. Cause classification: cold page cache × per-file IO count of the eager module graph; the app-owned, removable part of that graph is the eager transform-worker require. FIX (VERIFIED, in write_paths): metro-asset-transformer.cjs keeps the decoder guard eager and now exports { get transform(), get getCacheKey() } that require metro-transform-worker on first access, so metro/src/DeltaBundler/getTransformCacheKey.js and the Worker receive the identical upstream functions (asserted by identity in the new test) while the config process never loads metro-transform-worker/@babel/core. Existing tests for the fresh-worker guard path still pass. Tracer gained modules/majorPageFault/fsRead/context-switch fields so a future cloud timeout self-classifies as IO vs CPU. GUARDS UNCHANGED: 5000 ms timeout, --max-old-space-size=192, maxBuffer 1 MiB, SIGKILL, 32 trace records. CHECKS: AC1 5/5 cold runs 44/44 pass; AC3 tsc exit 0; AC4 eslint+prettier exit 0; pnpm format:check exit 0; git diff --check exit 0; full suite exit 0 with 5890 passed, 0 failed, 1 pre-existing Mac-artifact-gated skip (AC2 recorded FAIL against the literal 'no suite skipped' clause, see note).
